title: Purple Grape Juice with Vitamin C

content.title: About
content.content: Purple grape juice enriched with vitamin C is made from concentrate and shelf‑stable. It offers a rich berry flavor, the characteristic aroma of purple grapes, and an extra burst of freshness from added vitamin C.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Purple grapes contain more anthocyanins than light‑colored varieties, giving the juice its deep color and antioxidant power.
Vitamin C enhances the juice’s stability and provides an immune‑boosting boost.
Using concentrate preserves most nutrients while reducing package size.
Shelf‑stable formulation means the juice does not require refrigeration until opened.
Purple grapes have a long history of use in traditional medicine for cardiovascular support.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Anthocyanins and vitamin C help neutralize free radicals, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports immune function
items.content: Vitamin C contributes to a stronger immune system and faster recovery from colds.

items.title: May help lower blood pressure
items.content: Flavonoids in grape juice can improve vascular function.

items.title: Promotes gut health
items.content: Residual dietary fiber from the concentrate supports a healthy microbiome.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: High water content helps maintain proper fluid balance.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Concentrated juice can be high in natural sugars; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Grape allergy
items.content: Rarely, individuals may experience an allergic reaction to grape components.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The juice is acidic and may cause stomach discomfort in those sensitive to acid.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Small amounts of food‑grade preservatives may be used for shelf stability; those with sensitivities should check the label.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink it chilled as a refreshing beverage, blend into smoothies, use in cocktails, drizzle over desserts, or incorporate into marinades. It can also be diluted with water to reduce sweetness.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 7‑10 days.
